name: attention
description: Attention sensors — hook-only L1 plugin whose Claude lifecycle-hook sensors feed allowlisted runtime-owned executors (ADR-0040 §3, amended by ADR-0044 §2): notify.mjs emit for operator notifications and context.mjs publish-session for session capture. Registers Notification (permission_prompt → approval/urgent, idle_prompt → idle), Stop (session-capture spawn ordered before notification work — short-circuits never skip capture, capture failure never skips notification — then workflow-terminal behind a freshness-checked session-handoff projection read, else bare turn-complete), and SubagentStop (subagent-complete). Hooks + sensor scripts only: no skills, no verbs, no state machinery. Sensors are fail-closed silent observers (exit 0 always, never stdout, no decision output) that resolve the runtime plugin root via a version-gated discover-runtime ladder with dual floors (notify >= 0.71.0; publish-session >= 0.82.0, declared in data/runtime-floors.json byte-for-byte with the spawn gate); notifications stay off until the operator sets a notify_channel, and capture stays off until the operator sets session_capture, both via runtime:settings.
